# Still Enough

*Sorrel teaches Blink to any traveller who can sit through one of his listening lessons without fidgeting.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Fairy Forest](../towns/fairy_forest_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |

## Objectives

- Look at the listening bench in [Grove School](../maps/grove_school.md)
- Defeat 40 Creature of Shimmerwaters ([Firefly Slime](../monsters/firefly_slime.md), [Shimmer Slime](../monsters/fairy_slime.md), [Water Sprite](../monsters/water_sprite.md), [Forest Sprite](../monsters/forest_sprite.md))
